acceptance_predicates.description: The fault-matrix runner bounds output, time, workspace, subprocess lifetime, process-group descendants, cleanup, and network isolation with typed privacy-safe results.
Setup, recording, replay, benchmark, recovery, timeout, output overflow, malformed warning, unavailable isolation, and leader-exits-first descendant cases are exercised deterministically.
The exact reviewed implementation is signed/DCO-certified, independently approved, hosted-green, and merged with signed two-parent topology.
Missing authentication, signatures, and key-management services are visible warning-only development outcomes; production fail-closed behavior remains covered.
